dictionary.title: Who answers
dictionary.description: For each task choose the main model and its backups: if the first one fails or hits its spending limit, {assistant} moves to the next one by itself.
dictionary.auto_explain: In automatic mode the system picks the best available model. Choose one to decide yourself.
dictionary.routing_hint: How to split requests between conversation and work.
dictionary.routing_auto_hint: Splits only if the two tasks use different models.
dictionary.routing_1_hint: Short questions go to conversation, the rest to work.
dictionary.routing_0_hint: Everything goes to the work model.
dictionary.tester_hint: Type a sample request and see who would answer, without sending it.
